test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the father of B’,

A * B means ‘A is the husband of B’, and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P – Q ÷ R * S + T’?
solution:

Given: P – Q ÷ R * S + T

It means: P is the father of Q, Q is the sister of R, R is the husband of S, S is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b333317a419a56e3993b5414329c6740651b0b3d046ead3d36a009e643b403.png] 

Thus, P is T's Father’s Father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
